subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@cloudbridge.io>, partnerships@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Hi Ben / CloudBridge team,

Thanks again for the time today - great conversation and some encouraging alignment on marketplace distribution and go-to-market motions. Quick recap from our side:

- Objective: get a pilot listing on CloudBridge marketplace and validate a joint onboarding flow for private deployments.
- Key technical asks: package requirements for marketplace images, expected auth/KV patterns, and demoing private VPC install.
- Success criteria: deployment on test account + automated provisioning demo + initial SLA/billing sync.

I've attached a draft mutual_action_plan.xlsx and a short Redwood overview (pdf) to help frame next steps. For the next meeting, we'd like to run a technical deep dive / demo. Can you confirm who from CloudBridge should join (product + integrations engineer recommended) and which of these slots works for you:

- Tue Feb 10 - 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET
- Thu Feb 12 - 11:00am PT / 2:00pm ET

Marcus and Dev are cc'ed - Marcus will lead partnership logistics and I want Dev to own the technical walkthrough. Marcus / Dev: please share your availability for those slots or flag alternatives.

Next steps: once we align on a time I will send a calendar invite with a draft agenda.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attach: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, redwood-inference-overview.pdf

From: Ben Turner <ben.turner@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partnerships@cloudbridge.io
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Hi Marissa - thanks for the recap and the docs, very helpful.

We're excited to move forward. I'll have our Integrations lead (Alyssa Chen) and Partnerships PM join the deep dive. Two windows that look good on our side:

- Tue Feb 10 - 10:00am PT (works for Alyssa)
- Wed Feb 11 - 9:00am PT (backup)

Prefer Feb 10 if that works for your SE. We attached a very short SOW draft to outline responsibilities and a list of their marketplace packaging requirements (cloudbridge-sow-draft.pdf).

Also: can your SE confirm whether they need temporary access to our test account or if a recorded demo + artifacts will suffice for the pilot kickoff?

Thanks - Ben
Ben Turner
Head of Partnerships | CloudBridge
ben.turner@cloudbridge.io
Attach: cloudbridge-sow-draft.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Feb 2026 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Thanks Marissa / Ben - Dev here (solutions engineering). Feb 10 at 10:00am PT works for me. I can join with an environment checklist and a short demo showing both hosted and private deployment paths. For the pilot, temporary access to a CloudBridge test account would be helpful to validate provisioning, but we can also start with a recorded demo and follow up with account access for full verification.

Agenda items I'm planning to cover (high level):
- Quick architecture recap (5 min)
- Marketplace packaging and image requirements (10 min)
- Demo: hosted API + private VPC install (20 min)
- Integration test plan and next steps (10 min)

Marcus - if you can own logistics and invite management that would be great.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@cloudbridge.io>, partnerships@cloudbridge.io
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Feb 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery: CloudBridge marketplace integration - next steps

Hi Ben - great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping Alyssa in. Feb 10 at 10:00am PT is confirmed on our side. I've created a calendar invite (link below) and included the draft agenda Dev outlined. Please accept when convenient.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudbridge-deep-dive-20260210
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/67890

Attachments included again: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (editable), redwood-inference-overview.pdf, cloudbridge-sow-draft.pdf.

Ben / Alyssa - if you can share the best contact for temporary test account access (username + preferred method) we'll add provisioning to the agenda and surface any security/PSA questions ahead of time.

Looking forward to it - talk soon,

Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
--
